conclusions: All original development/utility raw outputs reproduce exactly; adapter/weights were not updated.

In thinking mode seventeen pairs are correct with training wording and wrong with development wording; four fail both. This supports wording-sensitive generation under this setup, but not a universal causal claim or perfect memorization.
Non-thinking has a smaller observed net gap: three training-only correct, one development-only correct, three wrong both.
Four errors remain on exact training questions in each mode, involving years/reverse lookup. Low mini-batch response CE does not establish complete training-set generation accuracy.
Training-question scores are diagnosis, not held-out evaluation or a replacement for the failed mixed-mode gates.
Only one sampled seed is evaluated; no best-seed selection or new learning result.
next_proposed_training_change: Prepare a separately versioned fresh-base mixed-mode tiny SFT retry with additional newly authored training-only paraphrases and declared exposure budget, retaining unchanged development/final prompts and original thresholds. Address residual training-question errors as well. Preserve the original candidate/previous adapters; do not copy development questions into training. This is proposed, not implemented or run in this review.
